title: bats-core inside agent + host fallback
objective: Enable test execution both inside and outside the agent container using bats-core, with host fallback installation, so that the project can validate itself ('little-mester against little-mester').

comments.author: cli
comments.body: ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ADDENDUM (2026-10-26). The bats suite must run in two places: (a) inside the agent image and (b) on the Docker-capable VM test host from ticket #35. Both runs use a disposable workspace, never the repo checkout as the target. A failing command must fail the suite with its real exit code/output, not be skipped or swallowed. tests/lab.bats and the sandbox verification pass after an image rebuild on the VM.

comments.author: migration
comments.body: Structured acceptance criteria and test ledger backfilled from the 2026-10-26 acceptance-criteria addendum. The original addendum above is retained as history; the structured fields are now the source of truth.

acceptance_criteria.text: The bats suite runs inside the agent image.
The same bats suite runs on the Docker-capable VM test host from #35.
Both runs target a disposable workspace, never the repo checkout.
A failing command fails the suite with its real exit code and output; nothing is skipped or swallowed.
tests/lab.bats and the sandbox verification pass after an image rebuild on the VM.

needed: run the bats suite inside the rebuilt agent image
assert failure propagation with a deliberately failing case
rerun tests/lab.bats and sandbox verification on the #35 VM
